name: poe-mcp
description: Poe (Quora) (marketplaces): me, list_products. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists the key owner's API bots.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET https://api.poe.com/bots ('None' query parameters) lists the creator's API bots in one response (page/limit ignored). id and name are the bot handle; price is not mapped: pricing is api_bot_settings.pricing {prompt, completion}, string dollar amounts PER TOKEN (in raw). is_private, model_name, base_url and api_type are in raw.
